title: Magenta craft as a trigger for the Axis

tellings.quote: just wonder was this part of what drove the decision to create what we now call the axis?

plain: A strange craft said to have come down near Magenta, in Italy, around 1933 may have helped push Italy and Germany into the alliance later known as the Axis, the pact behind their side in the Second World War. Harald Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, raises this as an open question rather than a claim, wondering aloud whether the craft drove that decision, which would mean a UFO helped shape the war.
